title: Vesper and the Playlist
author: Rafael Reyes
blurb: Ines Zhou, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
